blocks.title: Section 3 issue
blocks.text: Section 3 concerns unauthorised acts intended to impair computer operation, or reckless impairment. Evidence of deliberate disruption distinguishes this from merely accessing a file. Serious-damage provisions may apply to particularly grave cases.
